CDA’s objective is a fully integrated, city-wide Safe-City capability for Islamabad: end-to-end design, supply and installation of an approximately 1,200-camera CCTV network; the associated civil works (pole foundations, trenching/ducting, reinstatement on live roads); a redundant fibre backbone; and a central Command & Control Centre with video wall, storage and analytics—all delivered within an 18‑month completion window.

We understand that “success” for CDA is not only commissioning cameras, but achieving reliable, maintainable, and secure operations: resilient communications across a redundant fibre backbone, consistent video quality and retention, and a Command & Control environment that operators can use immediately for incident response, evidence handling and city-wide situational awareness. Given the command-centre data systems, CDA’s requirement for information security controls is central; we maintain ISO 27001 certification and have delivered cybersecurity engagements for government and international clients [CO-PROFILE][CAP-001][CAP-049].

Equally, CDA’s key risk area is civil execution on public roads—utility clashes, traffic disruption, and reinstatement quality. We recognize the need for disciplined work packaging, traffic-management planning, and CPM-based scheduling with contingencies. Our record includes road and bridge works delivery experience that informs this approach [CAP-003][CAP-027][CAP-028].

We also recognize the mandatory administrative framework: single stage, two-envelope submission under PPRA Rules 2014, and bid security of PKR 44 million via CDR/bank guarantee, which we can arrange within our bank guarantee facility [CO-PROFILE].

Where CDA’s eligibility thresholds exceed our current evidenced library, we will address them explicitly: our library does not yet evidence PEC constructor registration at C‑B or higher, ISO 14001 certification, PKR 2,500M average turnover, a PKR 1,500M prime safe-city project, or assured access to specified trenching/boring/pole-installation plant within 50 km; we will close these via compliant JV/partnering and documented equipment access arrangements.
